en: Member (Man)

jp: 早く行ってこい・・・
急ぐ時ほど、冷静さを忘れるなよ
en: Get going... The more you hurry, the more you need to keep a cool head.
Member (Woman)

jp: ちゃんと生きて帰ってくるのよ
en: ...Yes, good luck. You come back alive, you hear?
Member (Youth)

jp: ヴァルトス様といい勝負だ
en: You're a busy one... You could give Valtoss-sama a run for his money.

jp: どこかへ向かうらしい
en: Valtoss-sama is off somewhere again, it seems.

jp: いつもどこへ向かわれるのか、
誰にもその行き先を告げない・・
en: Wherever Valtoss-sama goes, he never tells anyone his destination...

jp: だが、そんなことはどうでもいい
俺達はヴァルトス様を信じてる
en: But that doesn't matter. We believe in Valtoss-sama.
Valtoss
Do you need something from me?
Cain

jp: ヴァルトスさん・・・
その腕の傷、どうしたんですか？
en: Valtoss-san... That wound on your arm, what happened?
Valtoss
Cain
...Valtoss-san?
Valtoss

jp: これは・・・なんでもない
en: A-ah... This is... nothing. Pay it no mind.
Valtoss

jp: 私も多忙な身だ・・・
en: Forgive me, but I am a busy man as well...

jp: ダリアに助言をこうといい・・
en: If anything comes up, ask Dahlia for advice...
Dahlia
You're in a hurry, right? Go on, get going.
Waiter
Now, hurry! We're rooting for you! Give it your all!!
Middle-aged Man

jp: 酒なんてやめてやる・・・
少しも酔えやしねぇんだ
en: I'm quitting the drink... However much I down, I can't get the least bit drunk.
Old Man

jp: いつもあそこで立っている
en: That old woman who's always standing over there...

jp: あの場所で、ケンカ別れした
息子の帰りを待っているんじゃよ
en: She's waiting in that spot for the son she fell out with to come home.
Young Man

jp: ああ、俺もいい加減に兄貴の店で
こき使われるのは疲れたから
en: Yeah, I'm tired of slaving away at my brother's shop. I want a shop of my own.
Well, once I've slacked off enough, I'll get back to work.
I've got a nice little find here...
This one, I can't really put out in the shop.

jp: キミに特別にあげるよ
en: I'll give it to you, special.
Payment?
Nah, nah, don't worry about it.

jp: いつか俺が店を持てたら
そん時は、ひいきにしてくれ
en: When I get my own shop someday, be a regular, all right?
Old Woman

jp: さすがに、お迎えが近いと
心細くなるもんじゃのう・・・
en: Keh keh keh keh. When your time's drawing near, you can't help feeling lonely...

jp: 最近、ケンカ別れした息子の
en: Lately I keep dreaming of my son, the one I fell out with.
Boy

jp: 大人達ってずるいよなー
en: Grown-ups are so unfair!

jp: 子供にはダメだと言ったくせに
自分たちは悪魔の公開処刑を
見に行くつもりなんだぜ？
en: They said no to us kids, but they're going to watch the demon's public execution!
Girl

jp: 文句ばっかり言ってるけど
本当は見にいかずにすんで
en: They grumble a lot, but really they're relieved they don't have to go see it.

jp: わたしは見たかったな～
en: I wanted to see it, though~ The demon's public execution.
Girl

jp: 悪魔は死ににくいんだって！
どれぐらい死ににくいのかな？
en: Mama said demons are really hard to kill! I wonder just how hard they are to kill?

jp: やっぱり、トマトみたいに、
踏みつぶしてぺちゃんこにする
くらいしなきゃダメだよね！
en: You'd probably have to squash them flat like a tomato for it to work, huh!
Clown
Soldier

jp: これは、かなり重傷だ・・・
en: Not good... This wound is pretty serious...

jp: あんな少女に心を乱されるなんて
俺は、どうかしているッ
en: Letting a girl like that get under my skin... What's wrong with me!
Plan
Welcome, welcome~ Full of pep today too!
Fly
Welcome~ Hard at it again today?
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
